findings.message: Confirm numeric CLEP score thresholds and the recommendation window in effect on the exam date. The retrieved university policy specifies C-equivalent minimum but not a numeric threshold.

The ACE College Algebra SOPH-0001 v6 period is verified as May 1, 2025 through April 30, 2028; current Sophia acceptance remains conditional. Precise Financial Accounting v5 dates and the exact recommendation periods of other community mappings remain unresolved.

Community-reported options outside the five independently school-submitted Sophia receiving maps still need current course/version, source recommendation period, receiving level and catalog research. The five documented named matches retain separate provisional-provider and personal-record conditions.

Study.com Accounting 302 has inconsistent reported titles across community pages. Confirm the exact current course and its ACC-4010 upper-level award, rather than inferring it from “Advanced Accounting.”

Study.com Business 308 SDCM-0054 v6 recommendation dates were not recovered. Business 306 SDCM-0071 v5 is dated June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2029; TESU must still confirm version, awarded level and individual catalog applicability.

No exact current outside mapping was established for ETH-2200 or BUS-2100. FIN-3010 has conflicting Study.com credit claims and remains unresolved. The featured SOC-2100 and FIL-1100 Human Cultures choices remain research gaps; other approved category choices may fit. MAN-3720 and MAN-3310 now have provider-published conditional candidates, not individual TESU approvals.

Scientific Knowledge category replacements BIO-1010 and NUT-1010 need written current-catalog allocation approval; the community roadmap alone does not certify their placement in this individual degree.
Prerequisites, future course offerings, official evaluation and personal catalog eligibility remain to be confirmed.
